sentences.text: Exterior of The Harborne Hospital, with the camera moving past foreground foliage to reveal the main building and its name signage while a white car drives past the entrance.

Low-angle exterior establishing shot of The Harborne Hospital, with the camera moving past foreground foliage to show the building facade and the entrance signage. A car drives past the entrance and a few pedestrians walk near the front of the building.
Low-angle exterior of The Harborne Hospital with the building name sign above the glazed ground-floor entrance, framed by a tree in the foreground as the camera moves past.

Gimbal push into an empty operating theatre at The Harborne Hospital, moving towards the operating table, with theatre lights, ceiling-mounted monitors, an anaesthetic machine and a surgical robot in the background.
An empty operating theatre at The Harborne Hospital, with the camera moving past an anaesthetic machine towards the operating table under ceiling-mounted theatre lights and monitors.

An empty operating theatre at The Harborne Hospital, with the operating table in the centre under ceiling-mounted theatre lights and monitors, and an anaesthetic machine and equipment towers around the room. The camera glides forward and across the room.

Gimbal move through an empty operating theatre at The Harborne Hospital, showing the operating table under the theatre lights, ceiling-mounted monitors, an anaesthetic machine, a surgical equipment tower and what appears to be a robotic surgical system by the back wall.

Empty operating theatre at The Harborne Hospital with an operating table under ceiling-mounted surgical lights, an anaesthetic machine in the foreground and an equipment tower and wall screens behind. The camera moves slowly sideways across the room.
An empty operating theatre at The Harborne Hospital, with the camera moving forward past the operating table towards the theatre lights, wall screens and a robotic surgical system parked at the side.

Gimbal move through an empty operating theatre at The Harborne Hospital, passing an anaesthetic machine and its breathing tubes to show the operating table under two theatre lights, with wall-mounted screens and equipment around the room.
Two surgeons in blue scrubs and theatre caps stand talking at the theatre department's staff desk while a colleague works at a computer behind the counter, with wall-mounted screens above.
Two clinicians in navy scrubs and theatre caps talk at a staff desk in the theatre department while a colleague works at a computer behind them. Wall-mounted screens and desk monitors are visible.
Two clinicians in blue scrubs and theatre caps talk at a theatre department desk while a seated colleague in scrubs listens and joins the conversation from behind a computer.

A nurse in navy scrubs and glasses sits at a nurses' station behind computer monitors and talks with a colleague, who is out of focus in the foreground with their back to camera. The colleague moves across the frame and partly blocks the view by the end of the shot.

Looking through a doorway gap into an empty critical care room with a made bed, ventilator, infusion pumps and monitors on a ceiling pendant. Near the end of the shot, a hand enters the frame and pushes the door.

A staff member's hand opens a door to reveal an empty critical care room at The Harborne Hospital, and the camera moves in towards a made-up bed surrounded by patient monitors, infusion pumps and a ventilator.

An empty critical care room at The Harborne Hospital, with a made hospital bed, overbed table, ceiling pendant, Philips patient monitor, ventilator and stacked infusion pumps beside a window. The camera moves sideways past a door frame to reveal the room.

The camera moves past a door frame to reveal an empty critical care bed space with a made hospital bed, a Philips patient monitor, infusion pumps on a drip stand and a ventilator. No people are present.
